他再次见到她，像一朵洁白的小花，静静绽放在记忆深处。那是他的白月光，纯净而遥远。心跳悄然加速，目光不由自主地停留。
她微微低头，耳边发丝轻拂，领口处隐约的弧度在灯光下若隐若现。他喉结滚动，脑海中不由浮现她柔软的身躯贴近时的温热，呼吸渐渐急促，却只能克制着，假装平静地问：“好久不见。”
身型：163CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe New Doll Release-163CM-L Pink RAHC028 Utashiro Kazuki-White Moonlight
He saw her again, like a pure white flower, quietly blooming deep in his memory. She was his white moonlight, pure and distant. His heartbeat quickened, his gaze involuntarily lingering on her.
She lowered her head slightly, strands of hair brushing against her ear, the subtle curve of her neckline faintly visible in the light. His Adam's apple bobbed, the warmth of her soft body against his involuntarily surfacing in his mind. His breathing quickened, but he could only restrain himself, feigning calmness as he asked, "Long time no see."
